title: Add Social Share
content: Create social share button group for major platforms. Container: flex items-center gap-2. Buttons: w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-colors. Platforms: Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Email. Each with brand color on hover. Icons: use lucide-react or simple SVGs. Share URLs: construct proper share URLs with encoded title and URL. Open in new window/tab: target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer". Optional: copy link button with "Copied!" feedback. Native share API fallback for mobile.

variants.simple: Create social media share buttons for sharing content.
variants.detailed: Create social share button group for major platforms. Container: flex items-center gap-2. Buttons: w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-colors. Platforms: Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Email. Each with brand color on hover. Icons: use lucide-react or simple SVGs. Share URLs: construct proper share URLs with encoded title and URL. Open in new window/tab: target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer". Optional: copy link button with "Copied!" feedback. Native share API fallback for mobile.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive social share component with native API support. Platform config array with: name, icon component, base URL pattern, brand color. Platforms: Twitter/X (twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=&url=), Facebook (facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=), LinkedIn (linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=), WhatsApp (wa.me/?text=), Reddit (reddit.com/submit?url=&title=), Email (mailto:?subject=&body=), Pinterest (pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=&description=), Telegram (t.me/share/url?url=&text=). URL construction: encodeURIComponent for text and URLs. Button styling: w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200. Default: bg-gray-100 text-gray-600. Hover: platform brand color background (Twitter: bg-black, Facebook: bg-[#1877F2], LinkedIn: bg-[#0A66C2], etc). Icon: w-5 h-5. Layout options: horizontal row, vertical stack, dropdown menu, floating bar (fixed side). Copy link button: with clipboard API, success state showing "Copied!" for 2 seconds. Native share API: detect navigator.share support, use as primary action on mobile with fallback to buttons. Share count: optionally fetch and display share counts (API dependent). Props: url, title, description, hashtags (for Twitter), platforms (array to show), layout, showLabels, showCounts, onShare callback. Accessibility: proper aria-labels "Share on Twitter", focus-visible states. Analytics: onClick handler for tracking shares.
